slug: 2024-11-19 HISP WCA develops DHIS2 EMIS for education data analysis and visualization in Togo

systems.tiers: Data from the 16,000 nursery, primary and secondary schools is collected on paper forms and entered into StatEduc at the education inspectorates

systems.owner: MEPSTA; built by HISP West and Central Africa with GPE KIX and Norad support
systems.tiers: Implemented in 2021 in interoperability with StatEduc, processing its data into dashboards and school report cards for schools and sub-national actors; under review by the ministry

note: No fact: StatEduc is the paper-collected statistical return keyed at the inspectorates and DHIS2 processes it. The article says the system supports individual-level data to track learners but does not say schools enter any.
